title: Retained watch overflow catch-up

effect.user: A connected watcher catches up retained audit history without a replacement snapshot.
assertions: Exact contiguous sequence and payloads; frames contain at most 256 events.
Real missing history requires gap and snapshot.
exclusions: Apiary folding/rendering and production overflow frequency

repeated.why: Repeated bursts of 512 renames exceed the 256-row threshold; ordinary deltas must converge without a replacement snapshot.

scale.why: Generated retained bursts and 20 KB/60 KB audit payload controls exercise row and byte prefix bounds; diagnostic populations remain separate.

fixture.seed: 1000 stopped bees with generated 19000-byte seals; 512 pipelined renames before 10-second flush

recipe.completion: Contiguous deltas or gap followed by replacement snapshot reaches target seq.
recipe.teardown: Stop only owned daemon; retain fixture and receipts.
requires: env -i with fake HOME/CODEX_HOME/CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR, HIVE_NO_KEYCHAIN=1 and fail-closed mock HIVE_TEST_SECURITY_BIN

metrics.scope: Replacement snapshot caused by retained overflow
metrics.invariant: All five captures: zero gaps/snapshot bytes; contiguous exact target cursor; <=256 events and <=128KiB encoded bytes OR one oversized singleton.
metrics.noise: Deterministic work count. Timing is satellite recipe evidence only.

gaps: No Apiary fold/install or UI transaction bound; no Studio timing or production overflow frequency.
Decoded-row amplification is scoped to decoded/enriched rows; each prefix still examines up to256 row-size metadata records.
Soft4ms per pass can be exceeded by one indivisible row; ordinary RPC response queues are outside watch queue bounds.
readiness: Measured deterministic transfer counts on metal-2: 5/5 retained512-event bursts use2frames/133008B and no replacement snapshot. Shared-host convergence timing is recipe evidence, not a Studio/Apiary baseline.

linked.why: Full initial snapshot remains necessary; rerun as displaced-cost control on the same satellite.
